import numpy as np
def bin_smooth(z,r,nb=25):
    qs=np.quantile(z,np.linspace(0,1,nb+1)); idx=np.clip(np.searchsorted(qs,z,side='right')-1,0,nb-1)
    means=np.array([r[idx==i].mean() if np.any(idx==i) else 0 for i in range(nb)])
    return means[idx]
